si.t: Enter the month or period covered, e.g. October 2026.
Use one currency throughout. Changing this label does not convert amounts.
Expected income from selling products or providing services.
Costs directly related to those products or services.
Business overheads, plus interest and income tax if applicable.
Gross profit minus indirect and other expenses.
1. Enter budget amounts in the yellow cells on the three input tabs.
2. Use the same period and currency for all figures. Enter costs as positive amounts.
3. Return here to see the automatic summary. Blank amount cells count as zero.
Each input tab has 20 lines. Rename the suggested categories to fit your business.
Asset purchases are listed separately below for donor review; they are excluded from the profit calculation above.
Excludes the Depreciation line on Indirect Expenses to avoid double-counting asset costs.
Full purchase cost from Asset Purchases, including the stated quantities and unit costs.
Enter owner contributions, other grants and project revenue committed to this budget.
Total project budget less other confirmed funding, with a minimum of zero.
Donor budget basis: planned costs for the stated project period; this is not a payment-timing cash forecast.
Revenue is not automatically deducted as funding. Include only revenue committed to the project in other confirmed funding.
Confirm donor eligibility of each cost, including interest and tax. Put depreciation only on the designated Depreciation line.
Enter your expected revenue. Rename or add items in the yellow rows.
Blank amounts count as zero. Notes can explain your estimate, e.g. 100 units × 5,000 IQD.
Other income from normal business activities.
Only yellow cells need input. The total above flows automatically to Summary.
Enter positive budgeted costs. List each expense only once across the cost tabs.
Cost of materials used for the budgeted sales.
Cost of the goods expected to be sold, not all stock purchases.
Labour directly attributable to making products or delivering services.
Packaging consumed for the budgeted sales.
Other costs directly attributable to products or services.
Support staff salaries; exclude labour already listed as direct costs.
Utilities treated as overhead in this simple template.
Delivery or transport treated as overhead; do not double-count direct costs.
Only the amount relating to this budget period.
The period’s depreciation expense, not the equipment purchase price.
Interest only; exclude loan principal repayments.
Enter an estimate if applicable; this workbook does not calculate tax.
Interest and income tax are included here separately so the summary can show net profit.
List the full purchase cost of equipment, furniture and other long-term assets needed for the project.
Yellow cells are inputs. Explain why each asset is needed so the donor can review the request.
Examples: coffee machine, laptop, refrigerator, desks or production equipment.
Include delivery and installation in unit cost when part of the asset’s purchase cost.
Full asset cost goes to the donor budget. Only depreciation goes to the profit summary.
State useful quantities and costs for this project only. Do not enter the same purchase under Direct Costs or Indirect Expenses.
